motivation: Preliminary first mixed crossover block: citation candidate delivered 32/32 basic correct but preserved the exact opening on only 1/32, versus 32/32 literal openings for original. Existing quality metric is insufficient for application adoption.
protocol: Independent two-boot crossover, same frozen binary, round-robin, same 48 historical plus 16 prospective seeds from citation-mixed, same eight waves and order. Control is the original unchanged request. Candidate appends a final instruction defining separate opening and explanation, keeping the 90-word task and exact ID requirement, without supplying IDs or numbers. Same contexts and SLOs. This is follow-up on the same workload, not an independent holdout.
gate: Recover original four missing-source seeds, preserve every control-correct seed, improve warm GPU-hour SLO goodput, retain <=5% common-correct p95 first/last/gap limits. Additionally require all candidate answers to keep the exact original opening and both measurements to carry their matching parenthesized ID in the separate explanation. Report failures, actual outputs, and any unsupported inference observed; never assume semantic truth from formatting.
